spec.name: sa-tech-founders
spec.title: South African Tech Founders & Engineering Leaders
spec.category: B2B Software, Developer Tools & Cloud Infrastructure
spec.target_market: Early-stage and growth founders, CTOs, and lead engineers in South Africa
spec.description: Technical decision makers building software businesses in South Africa, navigating local infrastructure realities, currency volatility, and remote hiring.
criteria: Actively operating as a founder, CTO, or tech lead in South Africa
Responsible for software purchasing or architecture decisions
sources: Stats SA QLFS formal ICT employment indicators
assumptions: High familiarity with cloud tools and remote developer workflows
Price sensitivity exacerbated by ZAR/USD currency exchange swings
